a third key added by two, at a row naming its addition
the third key evicted by the roster's count, at a row naming the eviction: no person
the other keys keep their person after the eviction
the evicted key at the eviction's own head, the eviction concurrent with the row: out (rule 4)
the evicted key at that head with no eviction held: its person then

the same key with only one of the two in the row's past

the key's revocation not in the row's past
